page.overview:
Who is Aered Argyris?

Aered Argyris was an male Alderaanian lieutenant who served in the Glare Peak civilian guard. He was stationed in the eastern part of Glare Peak and because of his anger at the Empire's destruction of Alderaan was sympathetic to the Alliance to Restore the Republic.
